textbookBox.concept: Prince Siddhartha was shocked at the age of 29 when he first saw an old man, a sick man and a dead body.

beats.en: Prince Siddhartha was shocked at the age of 29 when he first saw an old man, a sick man and a dead body. He left his home and after years of seeking he realised the truth and became the Buddha, the awakened one.
